# ui-worktree

Git worktree list with create, remove, prune (stale records and merged worktrees), sessions and merges.

- **Runs in:** the UI (your Emacs)
- **Source:** [lisp/ui/harness-ui-worktree.el](../../lisp/ui/harness-ui-worktree.el)
- **Loaded:** by default
- **Requires:** [ui](ui.md)
- **Brings along:** [worktree](worktree.md) (the rest of it)

## About

A `tabulated-list-mode` buffer of the git worktrees of the current
project: path, branch, head, flags (main, locked, detached, missing,
prunable), the working-copy status (clean or dirty, ahead/behind its
upstream) fetched per row after the list is shown, and the sessions
that live in each worktree.  The harness locks the worktrees it makes
until their branch is merged; the locked flag shows the reason.

Keys: n create a worktree, d remove (lifts the harness's lock; offers
--force when git refuses), p prune stale worktree records (keeps
locked worktrees, as git does), P remove the worktrees whose work has
already merged, l lock or unlock the worktree at point, L lock the
harness's worktrees that have no lock (made before locks, or
registered again after a prune), s start a session in the worktree at
point, f fork the current session into a fresh worktree, m ask for
the worktree's session to be merged back into its parent session (the
merge queue shows in the mode line), RET open the directory in Dired,
g refresh.
The mode line carries a clickable segment for every command.

Everything goes through ACP (`_harness/worktree/*`, `_harness/merge/*`,
`session/new`, `_harness/session/fork`).

## Provides

### Commands

- `harness-ui-worktree-create` — Create a worktree on BRANCH (from BASE with a prefix argument).
- `harness-ui-worktree-dired` — Open the worktree at point in Dired.
- `harness-ui-worktree-fork-session` — Fork SESSION-ID into a new worktree on BRANCH.
- `harness-ui-worktree-lock-existing` — Lock the harness's worktrees of this repository that have no lock.
- `harness-ui-worktree-merge` — Queue the session of the worktree at point for a merge into its parent.
- `harness-ui-worktree-mouse-dired` — Open the worktree clicked in EVENT in Dired.
- `harness-ui-worktree-new-session` — Start a new session whose working directory is the worktree at point.
- `harness-ui-worktree-prune` — Prune stale worktree records.
- `harness-ui-worktree-prune-merged` — Remove the worktrees of this repository whose work has already merged.
- `harness-ui-worktree-refresh` — Reload the list.
- `harness-ui-worktree-remove` — Remove the worktree at point; with FORCE (prefix) discard local changes.
- `harness-ui-worktree-toggle-lock` — Lock the worktree at point, or unlock it after asking.
- `harness-worktrees` — List the git worktrees of the repository at ROOT (default: this project).
